report.col.title: Report
report.empty: No reports yet. Use “Generate” or “New report”.
report.list_hint: Only the reports you created are listed. Filters use the report period: a report shows when its period lies completely in the range; reports without a period count by their creation date.
report.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}”? All versions are deleted and its documents go to the recycle bin.
report.field.title: Title
report.field.name: Report name
report.self_only: Members' reports contain their own results only
report.generated: Report generated and saved to the list
report.gen_help1: Choose the period, tasks and people, then click “Generate report”. It is saved to the report list automatically.
report.gen_help2: One section per task: its own results first, then each sub-task in the period with assignees, completion and results. When a sub-task has no results of its own, the results below it are listed in date order.
report.gen_help3: Only approved results are used. When a task and its parent are both chosen, it is listed once under the parent.
report.default_intro: This report covers {start} to {end}: {tasks} tasks and {items} approved results.
report.no_own_below: No results at this level; results below it by date:
report.no_sections: No matching tasks in this period
report.doc_delete_confirm: Delete this document? It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored within 30 days.
report.edit_gen_hint: Only the title and texts can be changed; tasks, completion and results come from the data. Each save keeps a version.
report.intro_hint: Leave empty to use the generated text
report.body_hint: Write a text or upload a document (or both); a finished Word file can simply be uploaded.
report.err.task_scope: Choose only tasks you can see
report.err.person_scope: Choose only people in your scope
report.err.body_or_doc: Write a text or upload a document
report.err.no_details: Reports written by hand have no Excel details
